definition: a large reptile that lived millions of years ago
sentence: The museum displayed a dinosaur skeleton taller than a bus.

definition: remains or traces of ancient life preserved in rock
sentence: Ace found a fossil of a fern leaf in the shale.

definition: no longer living anywhere on Earth
sentence: Dinosaurs became extinct about 66 million years ago.

definition: an animal that hunts other animals for food
sentence: Tyrannosaurus rex was a fierce predator with sharp teeth.

definition: an animal that eats only plants
sentence: Triceratops was a herbivore that munched on ferns.

definition: an animal that eats mainly meat
sentence: A carnivore needs sharp teeth to tear flesh.

definition: from a time before written history
sentence: Fossils help scientists study prehistoric life.

definition: to dig carefully in order to uncover something
sentence: The team will excavate the dig site for more bones.

definition: the science of studying fossils (Canadian spelling)
sentence: Palaeontology combines geology and biology to learn about extinct life.

definition: a period of the Mesozoic Era when many dinosaurs lived
sentence: Stegosaurus lived during the Jurassic Period.
